entities.name: João Santos Cardoso

entities.summary: João Santos Cardoso is a Brazilian Catholic prelate who has served as the Metropolitan Archbishop of Natal since July 2023. He became a bishop in 2011, and served as bishop of Roman Catholic Diocese of Bom Jesus da Lapa from 2015 to 2023.
